notes: Created initial story set for Specialty Match Transparency with full coverage across schema, logic, API/UI, tests, and integration. Avoided duplicate IDs per Claude warnings.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S1.title: Define Specialty Match Transparency Schema and Contract
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S1.description: Define response schema exposing matched_classifications, pipeline_origin (regex, vector, both), and confidence indicators for each specialty match. Ensure compatibility with existing provider search and specialty_service outputs.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S2.title: Implement Dual-Pipeline Attribution Logic
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S2.description: Enhance specialty_service to explicitly tag each matched classification with its originating pipeline (regex, vector, or both) and propagate attribution metadata alongside existing classification aggregation.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S3.title: Expose Specialty Transparency via EvaluateCare Facade
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S3.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade and/or find_care_facade to include specialty transparency fields in responses, ensuring downstream consumers (chat UI) receive pipeline attribution and classification details.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S4.title: Render Specialty Match Transparency in Chat UI
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S4.description: Update frontend message rendering to display matched specialties along with pipeline origin indicators (e.g., regex vs vector) in a user-understandable format within MessageBubble or ChatWindow.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Specialty Transparency
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S5.description: Add unit tests for attribution tagging in specialty_service and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from specialty identification through facade to UI payload structure.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY.mitigation: Leverage existing specialty_service outputs and limit changes to additive metadata only.
